name: Zinc oxide, Octinoxate, Enzacamene and Avobenzone
indication_description: This cream is indicated for protection from harmful UV rays and thus managing photodermatoses, skin pigmentation, solar urticaria, acute solar dermatitis, drug-induced photosensitivity, acute lupus erythematosus, polymorphic light eruption, etc.
pharmacology_description: This cream is a combination of 4 ingredients which provide a highly protective sunscreen action.Thus, it protects against the harmful effects of ultraviolet rays of sun which can cause skin cancer, wrinkle, premature aging and darkening of skin. Its Sun Protection Factor (SPF) is 60 & Protection Grade of UVA (PA) is +++, making it perfect for both UVA & UVB protection. Zinc Oxide acts as screen and reflects & scatters UV radiation in order to protect the skin.Avobenzone,Octinoxate and Enzacamene absorb UV radiation and convert it to heat, which is then released from the skin. Strong stay-on properties making it long lasting sunscreen.
dosage_description: Apply on the exposed area of the body to sunlight (such as face, neck & body) at least 30 minutes before exposure and whenever necessary. Massage on to skin until absorbed. To ensure maximum protection, repeat the application every two hours after continuous exposure to the sun and after swimming, physical exercise.
administration_description:
• Take an adequate amount of cream
  • Apply as a thin layer on the face or, other exposed body area
  • Gently massage onto the skin
interaction_description: It is not known whether this preparation has any interaction with other topically applied drug products.
contraindications_description: This preparation is contraindicated in patients with a history of sensitivity to any components of the preparation.
side_effects_description: Signs of irritations (erythema, burning or rash) may appear when applied to sensitive or broken skin.
pregnancy_and_lactation_description: Pregnancy Category C. It is not known whether this preparation is excreted in human milk. Caution should be exercised when this cream is administered to a nursing woman.
precautions_description: For external use only. Transient stinging or burning may occur when applied to abraded or broken skin.
pediatric_usage_description: Pediatric Use: The safety and effectiveness of this cream have not been established in pediatric patients.
storage_conditions_description: Store below 30°C. Do not freeze. Keep out of reach of children.
